title: Marque Advantage Report v2: pre-registered specification

referenceBlock.note: Mainnet head when this file was written. Each answer is graded at the block the agent's own answer states, re-read by Marque.

lockedBy: keccak256 of this file's bytes, written into the input data of a BSC testnet (97) transaction from the Marque team operator wallet before any task runs. Changing one byte changes the hash.

hire.how: Each task is hired through Marque's public hire API on BSC mainnet (56), BNB Chain's ERC-8183 escrow, from the Marque team test wallet 0x5aC2448FC79Ef8d33710b1Bced5AEff90138b452 (published team list; every job reads 'Marque team (test)' and is never counted).
hire.budget: At most 0.5 USDT (of which up to 0.25 USDT is swapped to U, the reference sellers' payment token, on the PancakeSwap v3 U/USDT 0.01% pool) and 0.002 BNB in network fees, across all three tasks.
hire.acceptanceTerms: Each hire proposes Marque's acceptance criteria for its category in the negotiate terms (packages/conformance/src/criteria.ts); sellers on the BNB Agent Studio SDK sign them into the job description on chain.

tasks.agent: Keel, ERC-8004 #341556 on BSC mainnet (Marque reference agent)
tasks.task: Health factor of Venus account 0x60AA3AEE06E2345A17E4d4B12c53E046F4F63CAf and the repay that restores it to 2.5.
rubric: Health factor within 0.005 of Venus at the answer's block
The repay amount brings the health factor to the target within 0.005
Liquidation price within 1 percent of Venus prices at the answer's block

baseline.method: A person reads the account on the Venus app and BscScan, computes the health factor and the repay to 2.5 by hand, timed from start to written answer.
baseline.ifNotRun: Marked 'not run' with the reason; the agent arm is still graded against the rubric.

tasks.agent: Sluicegate, ERC-8004 #341555 on BSC mainnet (Marque reference agent)
tasks.task: Where should 1000 USDT earn the most on Venus or Lista right now, net of switching cost?
rubric: Net APR is not above gross APR
Venus supply APR within 15 bps of Venus at the answer's block

baseline.method: 1000 USDT left idle earns 0 percent. The agent's route is a gain over this baseline only if its named route's net APR, re-read by Marque, is above 0 and every rubric line is met.

tasks.agent: Bound, ERC-8004 #341553 on BSC mainnet (Marque reference agent)
tasks.task: Re-centre PancakeSwap V3 position 7367728 of 0x2e010AaDFdFEbC2AdFCAFA5F83e9687ffA47C573 at +/-5%.
rubric: Current tick matches the pool exactly at the answer's block
Proposed ticks are multiples of the pool's tick spacing
In-range status matches the pool's current tick
The proposed range covers the current price

baseline.method: Leave the range as it is. The agent's plan is a gain over this baseline only if every rubric line is met and its proposed range covers the current price.

cost.agentArm: The quoted price paid into escrow (in U) plus the buyer's network fees, both read from the receipts.
cost.manualArm: Minutes of a person's time, recorded by that person; no money cost.

outcomeRule.win: Delivered within 30 minutes of funding, the answer file matches its hash on chain, and every rubric line is met (decided, not unchecked).
outcomeRule.loss: Not delivered within 30 minutes, the file does not match its hash, or any rubric line is not met.
outcomeRule.mixed: Delivered and matching, no rubric line failed, but at least one line could not be decided (a chain read failed or the answer lacked the input).
outcomeRule.versusManual: Where the manual arm runs: the agent is ahead if its outcome is a win and the person's answer misses a rubric line or took longer; level if both meet every line; behind otherwise.

publication: Every task is published on https://marque.trade/advantage with its job link, funder label, outcome and cost; losses are printed the same size as wins, with what this does not show.
